_header: harness/rules/teranode-gate.json: the data of #95's per-release gate (tools/teranode_gate.py, `make teranode-gate`), S3, lane gate-95, [D] 2026-10-17.

`scenario_rows` indexes every row of the scenario column (#66, the six families of harness/src/scenarios/) to one row of #88's obligation list (corpus/teranode/obligations.json, the 54 ids of #87's map): per family an ordered list of rules, a rule matching a row by `id_in` (exact ids) or `prefix`; a row takes the earliest rule that matches it, and a family's last rule is its default. The index is the lane's reading of each row's subject [D], never a ruling: it says which obligation a measured verdict bears on, and the gate refuses a row no rule matches.

`class_divergence` names, per class of harness/rules/second-oracle-scenarios.json, the divergence of the obligation list (its `divergences[].id`) the class is the same difference as; an empty map means no scenario class is yet identified with a ruled divergence, so every scenario divergence is reported `open` (CLAUDE.md rule 15: the owner rules, the report cites).

`rulings` names, per divergence id of the obligation list, where its ruling stands (the decisions log entry or the card); the gate quotes it and never writes one. `ledger_ruling` and `scenario_ruling` name the same for the absence ledger's rows and the scenario column's classes.
